theme_strategy: Premium Dark Theme (Archetype 5: Luxury mixed with Tech). Focus on depth, mystery, and high-end aesthetics suitable for premium salons, elevated with smart AI technological undertones.

rules.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tight font-light text-white

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) for sticky headers, modals, and the video thumbnail overlay. Always include a 1px border-white/10 to ground the glass.
visual_enhancers.textures_and_glows: No full-screen gradients. Apply a subtle radial glow (accent_ai color, 15% opacity, max-w-lg) behind the video thumbnail or key AI features to signify 'smart AI'.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for main sections. Let the content breathe.
visual_enhancers.motion: Micro-interactions on hover for cards (slight lift, border glow). Smooth fade-in on scroll. Video play button should have a 'tracing beam' or soft pulse effect.

layouts_and_sections.referral_banner: If '?ref=' exists in URL, show a slim, elegant banner at the very top (bg-[#DFB78C] text-black text-sm py-2 px-4 text-center).
layouts_and_sections.sticky_nav: Crystal Glass header (z-50) fixed to top. Contains BrandMark Logo, Mira AI Studio, Features, Pricing, Verify Staff, Sign In, and 'Start free trial' CTA.
layouts_and_sections.hero_section: Immersive hero layout. Background uses 'hero_ai_background' heavily muted by bg-black/80 overlay to ensure maximum text contrast. Centralized H1 and subheadline. Two CTAs (Primary pill, Secondary outline). At the bottom of the hero, breaking the grid into the next section, is the floating video thumbnail card.
layouts_and_sections.video_thumbnail_treatment: A large, cinematic glassmorphic card (aspect-video) placed overlapping the bottom of the hero section. Uses 'salon_interior' or 'hero_ai_background' as the thumbnail image. Includes a prominent play icon with a glowing pulse in the center. On click, triggers a Dialog/Modal containing a full-screen HTML5 video player for '/miracurl-full-tour.mp4'.
layouts_and_sections.stats_strip: 4-column grid immediately following the hero. Subtle border-r border-white/10 between items (except last). Includes: ₹0 setup, 90 sec to go live, 24/7 AI receptionist, 0% booking commission.
layouts_and_sections.features_bento: Asymmetric Bento grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12) for the top features (Mira AI, Smart POS, Staff Registry, Online Booking). Sub-features (9 items) can be a 3-column dense grid below.
layouts_and_sections.reusable_components: Maintain existing components (DemoCarousel, MiraStudioShowcase, SoftwareFlowSection, TrustedPartnersSection, SalesChatWidget) but map them to the new dark/gold color palette and typography rules.
layouts_and_sections.testimonials: Live partner grid using 'owner_portrait', left-aligned, showing authentic salon owners.
layouts_and_sections.pricing_section: Clean UI with a Region Toggle (India ₹ / International $). India: 4 columns. International: 3 columns. Below pricing, add an Enterprise block (full width) offering 'Book a Demo' and 'WhatsApp chat'.

components_to_implement: Dialog component for full-screen video player
Button component (customized to pill shape with new colors)

accessibility.contrast: Text over backgrounds must exceed 4.5:1 ratio. Ensure CTAs use dark text (#050505) over the primary gold (#DFB78C) for readability.
accessibility.data_testid: Apply data-testid to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='hero-video-play', data-testid='start-free-trial', data-testid='pricing-toggle-inr').

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for headers, overlays, or dropdowns. Always use backdrop-blur with a background color (e.g. bg-black/60).
Do NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties to avoid breaking transforms.
Avoid generic centered layouts. Align content to the left for better readability, except for hero headers.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
Create components as .js files (not .tsx) inside src/components/ui/ matching existing project conventions.
instructions_to_main_agent: Perform a comprehensive redesign for the Miracurl landing page. Apply the Premium Dark Theme blueprint. Implement a custom video thumbnail that sits overlapping the hero and the next section. Use 'salon_interior' or 'hero_ai_background' as the poster image. This thumbnail must open '/miracurl-full-tour.mp4' in a fullscreen Modal/Dialog upon click. Integrate existing reusable components smoothly into the new dark layout, verify the presence of '?ref=' to conditionally render a referral banner, and apply all specified layout rules.
